flow_ref: User story (not in the OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: Returning to the generic Notice address edit form exists (Sebagian); the option to reject a Letter of Advice has no code.
note: Synonyms tried across the six repos (UI and API): letter of advice, LOA, advice, warrant, WOA, court letter, court batch, last known address, defendant address, pre-populated, OIC. Found only: labels in ocmsadminui/src/i18n/en/translation.json:122-123 (letter_of_advice, letter_of_advice_list; not used by any component), System.ts constants (COURT_BATCH_LIMIT, WARRANT_SETTLE_DATE) with no backend resource, a UI call to /v1/warrantofarrest (ocmsadminui/src/pages/NoticeSearch/hook/useSearch.ts:69-74) with no Java controller, and the OcmsCourtCase entity (ocms_court_case) with no controller. The only court endpoint in the backend is CasIntegrationController (CAS to OCMS), which is not credited. What exists is the generic Owner/Driver/Hirer address edit on the Notice page (Edit, save, Cancel), not a Letter of Advice decision flow; counted as Sebagian only. The court record update (defendant address into ocms_court_case) in useODH.tsx:380-399 is commented out. Story status is blank in the data (requirement not given); traced normally. Maintenance tickets: grep letter of advice / warrant / court batch / last known = 0 matches, none used.
recommendation: Evidence 33%. Only the generic Notice address edit form exists; do not claim a previous Letter of Advice screen or the reject option.

steps.step: OCMS reverts to the previous screen after the officer cancels the decision to proceed
steps.detail: After the dialog closes the Owner form is still in edit mode (useODH.tsx:485-492); the Cancel button (useODH.tsx:503-511) resets the fields to the original data. This is the 'previous screen' of the general Notice page, not a Letter of Advice decision screen; Sebagian (same as OCMS27.9 step 3).

steps.step: Officer can edit the address again and save
steps.detail: Editing and saving the address again works through the generic Owner edit flow (useODH.tsx:349-376, server ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsOffenceNoticeOwnerDriverAddr/OcmsOffenceNoticeOwnerDriverAddrController.java:94). The court record update is commented out (ocmsadminui/src/pages/Notice/hook/useODH.tsx:380-399). Sebagian (same as OCMS27.7 save step).

steps.step: Officer can change the decision to reject sending the Letter of Advice
steps.detail: No code: only the text label 'Letter of Advice' at ocmsadminui/src/i18n/en/translation.json:122-123, used by no component; no screen, endpoint, or table for a Letter of Advice decision. No reject Letter of Advice action on any screen (see OCMS27.6).
